KIND:       Input.ChoiceSet
SCHEMA:     card (vendor/skills-for-copilot-studio @ 9c42d3a)

DESCRIPTION:
    Allows a user to input a Choice.

    YAML: `type: Input.ChoiceSet`

FIELDS:
  type	<string>
    Must be `Input.ChoiceSet`

  choices	<[]Input.Choice>
    `Choice` options.

  choices.data	<Data.Query>
    Allows dynamic fetching of choices from the bot to be displayed as
    suggestions in the dropdown when the user types in the input field.
    since Adaptive Cards v1.6

  errorMessage	<string>
    Error message to display when entered input is invalid
    since Adaptive Cards v1.3

  fallback	<ImplementationsOf.Element | FallbackOption>
    Describes what to do when an unknown element is encountered or the requires
    of this or any children can't be met.
    enum: drop
    since Adaptive Cards v1.2
    one of 16 kinds: cse card:Input.ChoiceSet.fallback

  height	<BlockElementHeight>
    Specifies the height of the element.
    enum: auto, stretch
    since Adaptive Cards v1.1

  id	<string> -required-
    Unique identifier for the value. Used to identify collected input when the
    Submit action is performed.

  inputStyle	<InputStyle>
    [SUPPORTED ONLY IN JAVASCRIPT SDK] Style hint for input fields. Allows input
    fields to appear as read-only but when user clicks/focuses on the field, it
    allows them to update those fields.
    enum: revealOnHover, default
    since Adaptive Cards v1.6

  isMultiSelect	<boolean>
    Allow multiple choices to be selected.
    default: false

  isRequired	<boolean>
    Whether or not this input is required
    since Adaptive Cards v1.3

  isVisible	<boolean>
    If `false`, this item will be removed from the visual tree.
    default: true
    since Adaptive Cards v1.2

  label	<string>
    Label for this input
    since Adaptive Cards v1.3

  labelPosition	<InputLabelPosition>
    [SUPPORTED ONLY IN JAVASCRIPT SDK] Determines the position of the label. It
    can take 'inline' and 'above' values. By default, the label is placed
    'above' when label position is not specified.
    enum: inline, above
    since Adaptive Cards v1.6

  labelWidth	<string | number>
    [SUPPORTED ONLY IN JAVASCRIPT SDK] Determines the width of the label in
    percent like 40 or a specific pixel width like '40px' when label is placed
    inline with the input. labelWidth would be ignored when the label is
    displayed above the input.
    since Adaptive Cards v1.6

  placeholder	<string>
    Description of the input desired. Only visible when no selection has been
    made, the `style` is `compact` and `isMultiSelect` is `false`

  requires	<map[string]string>
    A series of key/value pairs indicating features that the item requires with
    corresponding minimum version. When a feature is missing or of insufficient
    version, fallback is triggered.
    since Adaptive Cards v1.2

  separator	<boolean>
    When `true`, draw a separating line at the top of the element.

  spacing	<Spacing>
    Controls the amount of spacing between this element and the preceding
    element.
    enum: default, none, small, medium, large, extraLarge, padding

  style	<ChoiceInputStyle>
    enum: compact, expanded, filtered

  value	<string>
    The initial choice (or set of choices) that should be selected. For
    multi-select, specify a comma-separated string of values.

  wrap	<boolean>
    If `true`, allow text to wrap. Otherwise, text is clipped.
    since Adaptive Cards v1.2
